NoSQLServer v0.46 validation
============================

Focus
-----
ORDER BY execution complexity exposed by a real MariaDB/PyMySQL workload.

Observed external baseline
--------------------------
On the user's real wire-protocol workload with 5,007 rows:

  SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer;
    0.358 sec

  SELECT * FROM customer ORDER BY name DESC LIMIT 50;
    60.887 sec

Source diagnosis
----------------
The v0.45 ORDER BY path used stable insertion sort:
  O(n^2) comparisons

and compareOrderRows reparsed each textual ORDER BY specification on every
comparison. LIMIT was applied only after the complete sort.

v0.46 implementation
--------------------
- ORDER BY specifications are compiled once per query.
- General ORDER BY uses stable iterative merge sort: O(n log n).
- Ordinary SELECT with LIMIT/OFFSET passes offset+limit as a bounded-sort hint.
- Bounded ORDER BY uses a max-heap of size offset+limit followed by a stable
  sort of only the retained rows: approximately O(n log k), k=offset+limit.
- Stable input-order semantics are retained for equal sort keys.
- Existing ASC/DESC, multi-key, and NULLS FIRST/LAST semantics are unchanged.
- LIMIT remains semantically after ORDER BY.
- FETCH FIRST WITH TIES remains correctness-first and uses the complete final
  ordering boundary.

Local read-only benchmark
-------------------------
Synthetic NoSQLServer table with 5,007 rows, seeded directly in native storage
to isolate read/sort cost from INSERT cost:

  SELECT * FROM customer ORDER BY name DESC
    approx 1.07 sec wall

  SELECT * FROM customer ORDER BY name DESC LIMIT 50
    approx 0.58 sec wall

The local and external environments are not controlled-identical, so these
numbers are not presented as a formal speedup ratio. They demonstrate removal
of the pathological quadratic ORDER BY cost. The authoritative end-to-end
comparison should be the user's same MariaDB query against v0.46.

Capabilities
------------
- ORDER_BY_MERGESORT
- ORDER_BY_TOP_N

Regression evidence
-------------------
- v0.46 ORDER BY optimizer smoke: PASS
- v0.45 staged mutation graph: PASS
- v0.44 FK/event: PASS
- v0.43 database events: PASS
- v0.42 LIMIT/FETCH composition: PASS
- v0.41 LIMIT/OFFSET: PASS
- v0.38 NULL ordering: PASS
- database_core adapter: PASS
- SQL-92 company: PASS
- Claude torture: 12/12 PASS
- Grok hell v1: 24/25 PASS, 0 wrong results
- Grok hell v2: 13/30 PASS, 0 wrong results
- rexxc: NoSQLServer.cls and all tests/*.rex compile cleanly
